description: Berachain Proof-of-Liquidity telemetry from the public Berachain RPC: total BGT (Bera Governance Token) supply read from the BGT contract — BGT is minted only as PoL rewards, so its growth is the emitted amount — plus latest, safe and finalized blocks, finality lag, gas price (gwei), gas used % and average block time over the last 20 blocks. Per-gauge and per-validator splits are not read and not reported. Choose this tool for: Berachain Proof-of-Liquidity telemetry from the public. Close alternatives on this server: crypto_linea_consensys_rollup (Linea zkEVM rollup telemetry from the public Linea RPC); crypto_mantle_da_eigenlayer (Mantle Network L2 telemetry from the public Mantle RPC). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
